class="TextStandard__content--yeVj7"><div class="TextStandard__paragraph--Tbblv"><p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>Procure to pay is the process that integrates purchasing and accounts payable systems. It’s part of the wider procurement management process and involves four key stages:</span></p>
<ol class="TextStandard__listSpacings--C7jM6 List__numbered--g6MKQ"><li class="List__item--dF17N"><span class="List__content--gqTv5">Selection of goods and services</span></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><span class="List__content--gqTv5">Enforcement of compliance and order</span></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><span class="List__content--gqTv5"><a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="https://www.sap.com/use-cases/joule-assistant/receiving-ai" target="_self"><span>Receiving</span></a> and reconciliation</span></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><span class="List__content--gqTv5">Invoicing and payment</span></li></ol>
<p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>Digitalizing your procure-to-pay process with procure-to-pay software can strengthen compliance and control among vendors, contracts, regulations, buyers, and accounts payable. Procure-to-pay solutions help you automate processes so you can buy from preferred suppliers at negotiated prices without manual paperwork. This helps you actively control and improve global spend, reduce manual errors, streamline catalog maintenance, and speed up approval of new suppliers.</span></p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></dd></div></div><div class="" data-component-name="AccordionItem"><div class="" role="listitem"><dt class="AccordionItemCommon__openerWrapper--j_RPs"><button class="AccordionItemCommon__opener--jl1dQ" data-focus="accordionItem" aria-expanded="false"><span class="AccordionItemCommon__arrowIcon--hyQes" aria-hidden="true"><svg height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g id="slim-arrow-right-1791559943828-33sqn"><path d="m5.8 13c-.21 0-.42-.08-.58-.25-.31-.32-.29-.83.03-1.13l3.79-3.62-3.79-3.62c-.32-.31-.33-.81-.03-1.13.31-.32.81-.33 1.13-.03l4.4 4.2c.16.15.25.36.25.58s-.09.43-.25.58l-4.4 4.2c-.15.15-.35.22-.55.22z"></path></g></svg></span><h3 class="Headline__root--lKpRX AccordionItemCommon__title--SefAq Headline__headline-xxxs--ix9XF Headline__medium--irDyM Headline__color--A3sZu">Is procure to pay the same as accounts payable?</h3></button></dt><dd class="AccordionItemCommon__slideAccordion--IQzm8"><div class=""><div class=" dx-row5-12-4 textStandard section dx-1203d8ae89254e4a37f645bbb08af355f8b9236b" data-component-name="TextStandard"><div class="Grid__container--LFiYT TextStandard__root--doEk4 TextStandard__left--OHU7f"><div class="Grid__no-gutters--CKl5Z Grid__row--SkLLf "><div class="Grid__col-12--cMZPy Grid__col-sm-12--JrL2M Grid__col-md-12--tG5nF Grid__col-lg-12--wWsJK Grid__col-xl-12--v6LlR TextStandard__alignmentStart--ZPElv"><div class="TextStandard__content--yeVj7"><div class="TextStandard__paragraph--Tbblv"><p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>Procure to pay is not the same as accounts payable. Procure to pay is the end-to-end process that enables procurement and accounts payable teams to buy and then pay vendors for goods or services. Organizations often use procure-to-pay software to digitalize and automate key procure-to-pay activities while <a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="//www.sap.com/products/spend-management/procure-to-pay/features/guided-buying.html" target="_self"><span>guiding buyers</span></a> to comply with procurement rules. The <a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="//www.sap.com/products/spend-management/ariba-invoicing.html" target="_self"><span>invoice management</span></a> and payment steps of the procure-to-pay process are handled by the accounts payable team.</span></p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></dd></div></div><div class="" data-component-name="AccordionItem"><div class="" role="listitem"><dt class="AccordionItemCommon__openerWrapper--j_RPs"><button class="AccordionItemCommon__opener--jl1dQ" data-focus="accordionItem" aria-expanded="false"><span class="AccordionItemCommon__arrowIcon--hyQes" aria-hidden="true"><svg height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g id="slim-arrow-right-1791559943829-oyuvz"><path d="m5.8 13c-.21 0-.42-.08-.58-.25-.31-.32-.29-.83.03-1.13l3.79-3.62-3.79-3.62c-.32-.31-.33-.81-.03-1.13.31-.32.81-.33 1.13-.03l4.4 4.2c.16.15.25.36.25.58s-.09.43-.25.58l-4.4 4.2c-.15.15-.35.22-.55.22z"></path></g></svg></span><h3 class="Headline__root--lKpRX AccordionItemCommon__title--SefAq Headline__headline-xxxs--ix9XF Headline__medium--irDyM Headline__color--A3sZu">What is SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing?</h3></button></dt><dd class="AccordionItemCommon__slideAccordion--IQzm8"><div class=""><div class=" dx-40013073605e2225b33a7107498a3cc1d4c9dcb2 dx-row5-12-5 textStandard section" data-component-name="TextStandard"><div class="Grid__container--LFiYT TextStandard__root--doEk4 TextStandard__left--OHU7f"><div class="Grid__no-gutters--CKl5Z Grid__row--SkLLf "><div class="Grid__col-12--cMZPy Grid__col-sm-12--JrL2M Grid__col-md-12--tG5nF Grid__col-lg-12--wWsJK Grid__col-xl-12--v6LlR TextStandard__alignmentStart--ZPElv"><div class="TextStandard__content--yeVj7"><div class="TextStandard__paragraph--Tbblv"><p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing is a software-as-a-service solution. It provides ease of use, compliance, and flexibility throughout the procure-to-pay process. From small, growing companies to large enterprises, this procure-to-pay software helps organizations streamline catalog maintenance, simplify commerce, and efficiently manage workflows for procure to pay.</span></p>
<p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span> </span></p>
<p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>Intuitive tools provide users with straightforward ways to search for goods and services. Meanwhile, <a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="//www.sap.com/products/spend-management/procure-to-pay/features/guided-buying.html" target="_self"><span>guided buying</span></a> functionality, preconfigured approval workflows, budget checks, and <a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="//www.sap.com/products/spend-management/contract-management-software.html" target="_self"><span>contract management</span></a> capabilities help ensure compliant spend.</span></p>
<p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span> </span></p>
<p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>The procure-to-pay solution also enables the creation and validation of invoices from buyers, suppliers, and third parties. Based on user-defined business rules, invoices are systematically matched against POs, contracts, and receipts with invalid invoices sent back to suppliers. After validation, the procure-to-pay solution begins exception handling and workflow approval, which includes automatic escalation and delegation to help ensure that invoices are processed quickly and effectively. After final approval, invoices can be directly linked to your integrated payment process.</span></p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></dd></div></div><div class="" data-component-name="AccordionItem"><div class="" role="listitem"><dt class="AccordionItemCommon__openerWrapper--j_RPs"><button class="AccordionItemCommon__opener--jl1dQ" data-focus="accordionItem" aria-expanded="false"><span class="AccordionItemCommon__arrowIcon--hyQes" aria-hidden="true"><svg height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g id="slim-arrow-right-1791559943831-ffd9u"><path d="m5.8 13c-.21 0-.42-.08-.58-.25-.31-.32-.29-.83.03-1.13l3.79-3.62-3.79-3.62c-.32-.31-.33-.81-.03-1.13.31-.32.81-.33 1.13-.03l4.4 4.2c.16.15.25.36.25.58s-.09.43-.25.58l-4.4 4.2c-.15.15-.35.22-.55.22z"></path></g></svg></span><h3 class="Headline__root--lKpRX AccordionItemCommon__title--SefAq Headline__headline-xxxs--ix9XF Headline__medium--irDyM Headline__color--A3sZu">If I need assistance with my cloud trial, what should I do?</h3></button></dt><dd class="AccordionItemCommon__slideAccordion--IQzm8"><div class=""><div class=" dx-38facbfb9e04840e50ea8c2b6ad966bbf75aae38 textStandard section dx-row5-12-2" data-component-name="TextStandard"><div class="Grid__container--LFiYT TextStandard__root--doEk4 TextStandard__left--OHU7f"><div class="Grid__no-gutters--CKl5Z Grid__row--SkLLf "><div class="Grid__col-12--cMZPy Grid__col-sm-12--JrL2M Grid__col-md-12--tG5nF Grid__col-lg-12--wWsJK Grid__col-xl-12--v6LlR TextStandard__alignmentStart--ZPElv"><div class="TextStandard__content--yeVj7"><div class="TextStandard__paragraph--Tbblv"><p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>You can request support by creating a case/service request using the SAP Industries & Experience Self-Services tool. <a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="https://sapit-services-prod-emu-intelligent-enterprise-service-4bd032e8.cfapps.eu10-004.hana.ondemand.com/esm/cases/six" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><span>Visit the tool.</span></a></span></p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></dd></div></div></div></dl></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section></div>

      const callback = (event_data) => {
        if (!event_data || !event_data.events) return;

        const country = event_data.page?.country;
        const user_data = formatUser(event_data);
        const page = formatPage(event_data);
        globalDL(country, user_data, page);

        /*
         temp solution. Some _trackData calls e.g. form or asset object for non-form/asset event that was 
         included in legacy imp. This "worked" because _trackData is stateless. But EDDL is not stateless. 
         So for hybrid solution, include some stuff as "global" (e.g. form, asset) to cover those scenarios.
         proper/full native EDDL will introduce new events for those specific scenarios.
         */
        globalHybridDL(event_data);
      
        let count = 0;
        const isPageView = !!event_data.events.pageView;
        if (isPageView) {

            pushEDDLEvent(eddlMapping["pageView"](event_data));

            simulateLogout(event_data);
            count++;
        }

        let otherEvents = Object.keys(event_data.events).filter(e => e !== "pageView");
        for (const event of otherEvents) {
            const mapping = eddlMapping[event];
            if (!mapping) continue;

            const result = mapping(event_data);
            if (!result) continue;

            if (Array.isArray(result)) {
                for(const r of result) {
                    if (!r) continue;

                    pushEDDLEvent(r);
                    count++;
                }
            } else {
                pushEDDLEvent(result);
                count++;
            }
        }

        if (count != 0) pushEDDLBeacon(isPageView);
        
        if (isPageView) {
          window.SAP = window.SAP || {};
          window.SAP.sapdx = window.SAP.sapdx || {};
          window.SAP.sapdx.analytics = window.SAP.sapdx.analytics || {};
          window.SAP.sapdx.analytics.datalayer = window.SAP.sapdx.analytics.datalayer || {};
          window.SAP.sapdx.analytics.datalayer.pageview = window.SAP.sapdx.analytics.datalayer.pageview || {};
          window.SAP.sapdx.analytics.datalayer.pageview.wasTriggered = true;
          
          document.dispatchEvent(new Event('pageViewTriggered'));
        }
      };
        
      if (window.SAP && window.SAP.asyncDataProviders && Array.isArray(window.SAP.asyncDataProviders.promises)) {
        Promise.all(window.SAP.asyncDataProviders.promises).then(() => callback(data));
      } else {
        callback(data);
      }
    }

    if(typeof globalThis !== "undefined") globalThis.eddlTranslate = eddlTranslate;

    //var isFromSAP = _satellite.getVar('isFromSAP');

        window.sapcomDataLayer.push(event_data);
      
        if (_satellite.getVar('isLaunchStagingDebug')) {
          console.log("***processing DL begin***");
          console.log('event:',event);
          console.log('event_data:',JSON.stringify(event_data,null,4));
        }
      
        eddlTranslate(event_data);
        
        if (_satellite.getVar('isLaunchStagingDebug')) {
          console.log("***processing DL end***");
        }
    });

    document.body.addEventListener(tdEventName, function (event) {

        if (_satellite.getVar('isLaunchStagingDebug')) {

        }
      
        eddlTranslate(event_data);
        
        if (_satellite.getVar('isLaunchStagingDebug')) {
          console.log("***processing DL end***");
        }
    }, false);
    SAP.eddlTranslationLoaded = true;
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("eddlTranslationLoaded"));

var ChatLeadClient = {
  CHAT_LEAD_VISITOR_HISTORY: "CHAT_LEAD_VISITOR_HISTORY",
  trackedEvents: {
    "pageView": [2, 12],
    "downloadSuccess": [1,4],
    "pdfPreview": [1,4],
    "freeTrial": [1,2],
    "formSubmit": [1,2],
    "mediaClose": [1,4],
    "sessionCount": [1,3]},

    loadVisitorHistory: function () {
      var data = localStorage.getItem(this.CHAT_LEAD_VISITOR_HISTORY);
      if (data) data = JSON.parse(data);
      return data;
    },

    saveVisitorHistory: function (history) {
      localStorage.setItem(this.CHAT_LEAD_VISITOR_HISTORY, JSON.stringify(history));
    },

    saveVisitorHistoryOnPageView: function () {
      var history = this.loadVisitorHistory() || {};

      history.pageView = history.pageView || 0;
      history.pageView++;  

      var last_session_id = history.last_session_id || "";
      var session_id = _satellite.cookie.get('session');
      if (session_id != last_session_id) {
        history.last_session_id = session_id;
        history.sessionCount = history.sessionCount || 0;
        history.sessionCount++;
      } 

      this.saveVisitorHistory(history);
  },
  saveVisitorOnEvents: function(events) {
    var history = this.loadVisitorHistory() || {};

    console.log("[CHAT LEAD]event:", events);
    if (events) {
      for (e in events) {
          if (e in ChatLeadClient.trackedEvents) {
            history[e] = history[e] || 0;
            history[e]++;
          }
      }
    }
    
    this.saveVisitorHistory(history);
  }
};


$(document).on('trackData', function (event, args) {
    if (!args.events) return;
    console.log("[Lead Prediction] $document:", event, args)

    if (args.events.pageView) 
      ChatLeadClient.saveVisitorHistoryOnPageView()
    else 
      ChatLeadClient.saveVisitorOnEvents(args.events);
});

document.body.addEventListener('trackData', function (event) {
  var args = event && event.detail || {};
  if (!args.events) return;
  console.log("[Lead Prediction]document.body:", event, args)
  if (args.events.pageView) 
    ChatLeadClient.saveVisitorHistoryOnPageView()
  else 
    ChatLeadClient.saveVisitorOnEvents(args.events);
}, false);

var chatLeadRecSysURL = "https://api.services.sap.com/ngds/chat-helper-service/v1/process-for-user";
if(window.SAP && window.SAP.DTM && window.SAP.DTM.runMode == "qa") 
  chatLeadRecSysURL = "https://api.services-qa.sap.com/ngds/chat-helper-service/v1/process-for-user";

$(document).ready(function() {
  var history = ChatLeadClient.loadVisitorHistory();
  if (!history || Object.keys(history).length == 0) return;

  var now = new Date();

  if (history.lastCallTime) {  
    if (now.getTime() - history.lastCallTime < 3600000) {
        return;
    }
  }

  var okToGo = false;
  for (e in ChatLeadClient.trackedEvents) {
    if (!(e in history)) continue;

    if (history[e] >= ChatLeadClient.trackedEvents[e][1]) {
      okToGo = false;
      break;
    };

    if (history[e] >= ChatLeadClient.trackedEvents[e][0]) {
      okToGo = true;
    };
  }

  if (!okToGo) return;

  var chatLeadListenerReady = false;
  var chatPredictionData;

  function triggerChatInvite(data) {
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (window.createEvent)
        document.dispatchEvent(createEvent('PossibleChatLead', data));
    }, 30000);
  }

  document.addEventListener("ChatLeadListenerReady", function(e) {
    chatLeadListenerReady = true;
    if (chatPredictionData) {
      triggerChatInvite(chatPredictionData);
    }
  });

  function checkPredictionResult(data) {
    console.log("[Lead Prediction]from rec engine:", data);
    if (data["user-effect"] >= 0.45) {

      //REVIEW
      history.lastCallTime = now.getTime();
      ChatLeadClient.saveVisitorHistory(history);

      if (chatLeadListenerReady) {
        triggerChatInvite(data);
      } else {
        chatPredictionData = data;
      }
    }
  }

  var adobe_id = _satellite.getVisitorId().getMarketingCloudVisitorID();
  if (adobe_id) {  
    var url = chatLeadRecSysURL + "?payload_id=" + adobe_id + "&currentPage=" + window.location.href;
    $.ajax({
      type: 'GET',
      url: url,
      success: checkPredictionResult
    });
  }
});

            share_url: "https://linkedin.com/shareArticle?url=",
            fa_char: "fa-linkedin",
            fa_char_lightbox: "fa-linkedin-square"
        },
        pinterest: {
            share_url: "https://pinterest.com/pin/create/bookmarklet?url=",
            title_name: "description",
            fa_char: "fa-pinterest"
        },
        renren: {
            share_url: "http://widget.renren.com/dialog/share?link=",
            title_name: "title",
            content_name: "description",
            fa_char: "fa-renren"
        },
        reddit: {
            share_url: "https://reddit.com/submit?url=",
            title_name: "title",
            fa_char: "fa-reddit"
        },
        twitter: {
            share_url: "https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=",
            width: "550",
            height: "450",
            title_name: "text",
            fa_char: "fa-twitter"
        },
        weibo: {
            share_url: "http://service.weibo.com/share/share.php?url=",
            title_name: "title",
            fa_char: "fa-weibo"
        },
        vk: {
            share_url: "http://vk.com/share.php?url=",
            fa_char: "fa-vk"
        },
        xing: {
            share_url: "https://www.xing.com/spi/shares/new?url=",
            fa_char: "fa-xing"
        },
        email: {
            share_url: "mailto:?body=",
            fa_char: "fa-envelope"
        },
        wechat: {
            share_url: "",
            fa_char: "fa-wechat"
        }
    };

    const default_width = 550;
    const default_height = 450;
    const default_channel = "unknown";
    const sharing_params = {};

    /**
     * Add click event listener to all elements with the `data-is-share-link` attribute.
     * Triggers the sharing logic when these elements are clicked.
     */
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const shareElement = e.target.closest("a[data-is-share-link], button[data-is-share-link]");
        if (shareElement) {
            handleClick(e);
        }
    });

    /**
     * Add keydown event listener to support keyboard interactions.
     * If the space key is pressed on a share link, it triggers a click event.
     */
    document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        const shareElement = e.target.closest("a[data-is-share-link], button[data-is-share-link]");
        if (shareElement && e.which === 32) {
            e.preventDefault();
            shareElement.click();
        }
    });

    /**
     * Handles the logic when a share link is clicked.
     * @param {Event} event - The click event.
     */
    function handleClick(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        const element = event.target.closest("[data-is-share-link]");
        const channel = element.dataset.shareChannel || default_channel;
        let url = element.getAttribute("data-share-url");

        if (url && window?.parent?.location?.search) {
            const queryParams = new URLSearchParams(window.parent.location.search);
            const page = queryParams.get("page");
            if (page) {
                url += `&page=${page}`;
            }
        }

        if (channel === "wechat") {
            return;
        }

        handle_share_button(channel, url, (args) => {
            if (args.url) {
                window.open(args.url, args.target, args.size);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Constructs the full sharing URL and triggers the sharing action (popup or redirect).
     * @param {string} channel - The social media channel (e.g. "facebook").
     * @param {string} url - The URL to be shared.
     * @param {Function} processRedirect - Callback to handle the sharing (e.g., open a new window).
     * @param {string} [title] - The title to include in the share (optional).
     */
    function handle_share_button(channel, url, processRedirect, title) {
        title = title || document.title;

        const site = social_sites[channel];
        let width = default_width;
        let height = default_height;

        if (site) {
            if (!url) url = window.location.href;

            url = site.share_url + encodeURIComponent(url);

            if (site.title_name) {
                url += `&${site.title_name}=` + encodeURIComponent(title);
            }

            width = site.width || width;
            height = site.height || height;
        }

        sharing_params.target = "_blank";
        sharing_params.size = `width=${width},height=${height}`;
        sharing_params.url = url;
        processRedirect(sharing_params);
    }

    /**
     * Finds the appropriate FontAwesome icon class for a given channel.
     * @param {string} channel - The social media channel.
     * @param {Function} faCharPropertyCallback - Callback to extract the icon property.
     * @returns {string} The FontAwesome class name.
     */
    function resolveAwesomeFont(channel, faCharPropertyCallback) {
        const upperChannel = channel.toUpperCase();
        for (const ch in social_sites) {
            if (ch.toUpperCase() === upperChannel) {
                return faCharPropertyCallback(ch);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Get the FontAwesome icon class for a social media channel.
     * @param {string} channel - The social media channel.
     * @returns {string} The FontAwesome icon class (e.g., "fa-facebook").
     */
    window.getAwesomeFontName = function (channel) {
        return resolveAwesomeFont(channel, (ch) => social_sites[ch].fa_char);
    };

    /**
     * Get the FontAwesome icon class for lightbox usage for a social media channel.
     * Falls back to the regular icon if the lightbox icon is unavailable.
     * @param {string} channel - The social media channel.
     * @returns {string} The FontAwesome icon class for lightbox (e.g., "fa-facebook-square").
     */
    window.getLightboxAwesomeFontName = function (channel) {
        return resolveAwesomeFont(channel, (ch) => social_sites[ch].fa_char_lightbox || social_sites[ch].fa_char);
    };
})();
</script>
